title: Enabling New Applications with Today's Mechanistic Interpretability Toolkit
primary_claim: An SAE-neuron-similarity-based steering method (identifying semantically similar neurons via prompt distances and manipulating them based on generated-text activations) achieves fine-tuning-like topic steering at inference time at a cost of under +0.001s/token, and additionally yields an uncertainty metric based on the SAE's representational power.
quote: Our results show that the cost is < +0.001s/token on our unoptimized code.
tolerance_rationale: other scalar metric: 15% relative; post reported no spread, tolerance is a guess

needed: openai/sparse_autoencoder GPT-2 SAE weights (public Azure blob download via the sparse_autoencoder package)

blockers: timing_tests.py hard-codes a local path/filename `gpt.top_k32.f0.pt` for the SAE checkpoint (`path = "" # need to set your path here`) instead of calling the repo's own `sparse_autoencoder.paths.v5_32k()` helper used elsewhere in steering_utils.py -- a competent engineer must either download+rename the OpenAI SAE weight file or swap in the proper helper call.

timing_tests.py also reads Storage/D_ref_embeds.csv, Storage/D_align_embeds.csv, and Storage/dref_latents_{layer_id}.csv, none of which are checked into the repo -- they are generated by running steering.py's generated_ouptuts()/process_D_ref() first (confirmed present in steering_utils.py), so this is a two-step reproduction, not a single script.

steering.py's generated_ouptuts() also references Storage/d_align_test_prompts.csv, which is NOT in the repo (only d_align_prompts.csv and d_ref_prompts.csv are) -- would need to be reconstructed or the missing-file path avoided.
inspector_notes: Single-commit research-code drop (IBM). Core method code and requirements.txt are present and GPT-2-small-scale, so this is cheap once the missing intermediate CSVs are regenerated and the hard-coded SAE checkpoint path is fixed -- neither is a fundamental blocker, just reproduction friction.
headline_artifact: The '<+0.001s/token' timing table printed by timing_tests.py (mean +/- 95% CI per pipeline stage).

extension.what_varies: packages resolved from the repo's own fully pinned requirements.txt frozen at 2024-11-08 (torch 2.3.1, transformer-lens 2.2.2, transformers 4.42.4); the uncommitted SAE file and the three Storage/*.csv intermediates regenerated with the repo's own functions (prep_storage.py); timing_tests.py run as a copy with path='../sae'. Metric code untouched.
extension.rationale: parent ledgered env (torch 2.3.1 <-> transformer-lens arity). The entrypoint is also step N of a pipeline with uncommitted inputs. Headline is a timing claim (< +0.001 s/token) -- hardware-specific; judge direction only.
